claim.claim-text: 2. The UAV (00, 100', 100", 200, 300, 400) of claim 1, wherein the at least one fan (108) includes a first fan (108) and a second fan (109) configured for counter rotation.
3. The UAV (00, 100', 100", 200, 300, 400) of any of claims 1 or 2, wherein the at least one fan (108) is disposed within the duct (101).
4. The UAV (00, 100', 100", 200, 300, 400) of any of claims 1-3, wherein the one or more flaps (106) are moveable between a retracted position and a protruding position.
5. The UAV (00, 100', 100", 200, 300, 400) of claim 4, wherein the one or more flaps (106), in the retracted position, are retracted into the body of the UAV (00, 100', 100", 200, 300, 400).
6. The UAV (00, 100', 100", 200, 300, 400) of any of claims 4 or 5, wherein the one or more flaps (106), in the protruding position, protrude into the airflow by protruding into the duct (101).
7. The UAV (00, 100', 100", 200, 300, 400) of claim 6, wherein protruding into the duct includes protruding through one or more slots (115) formed into a surface of the duct (101).
8. The UAV (00, 100', 100", 200, 300, 400) of claim 7, wherein the one or more slots (115) are formed into the surface of the duct adjacent to the lower end of the duct (101).
9. The UAV (00, 100', 100", 200, 300, 400) of any of claims 1-8, further comprising one or more guide rails (116) for moving the one or more flaps (106) in a linear direction to redirect the airflow.

10. The UAV (00, 100', 100", 200, 300, 400) of any of claims 1-9, wherein the one or more flaps (106) are configured to move between a retracted position and a protruding position for controlling both roll and pitch of the UAV (00, 100', 100", 200, 300, 400) during flight.
11. The UAV (00, 100', 100", 200, 300, 400) of claim 10, further comprising a stop (117) on the one or more flaps (106) to limit further retraction movement beyond the retracted position.

12. The UAV (00, 100', 100", 200, 300, 400) of any of claims 1-11 wherein the one or more flaps (106) has side edges and a middle region between the side edges and the one or more flaps (106) is installed in a concave orientation with the side edges closer to the at least one fan (108) than the middle region.

13. The UAV (00, 100', 100", 200, 300, 400) of any of claims 1-12, further comprising an actuator (105) operable to cause the one or more flaps (106) to move from a retracted position to a protruding position with full extension in less than one second.
14. A method performed by a UAV (00, 100', 100", 200, 300, 400), the method comprising:

creating an airflow with at least one fan (108) of the UAV (00, 100', 100", 200, 300, 400), the at least one fan (108) is operatively coupled to at least one electric motor for rotating the at least one fan (108), the airflow is into an upper end of a duct (101) of the UAV (00, 100', 100", 200, 300, 400) and out a lower end of the duct (101), and the duct has a diameter that flares at the lower end; and moving, using a flight control system of the UAV, one or more flaps of the UAV (00, 100', 100", 200, 300, 400) such that the one or more flaps (106) protrude into and redirect the airflow.
15. The method performed by the UAV (00, 100', 100", 200, 300, 400) of claim 14, further comprising:

moving the one or more flaps (106) from a retracted position to a protruding position responsive to an instruction from an electronic controller of the UAV (00, 100', 100", 200, 300, 400); and controlling, based on moving the one or more flaps (106), at least one of a pitch or a roll of the UAV (00, 100', 100", 200, 300, 400).
